findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commercebook_feedback, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search · Private data: commercebook_start, commercebook_market · Public sink: commercebook_start, commercebook_market, commercebook_capabilities, commercebook_feedback, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commercebook_feedback, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search · Private data: commercebook_start, commercebook_market · Public sink: commercebook_start, commercebook_market, commercebook_capabilities, commercebook_feedback, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
